maintenanceTab.title: Scheduled maintenance
maintenanceTab.intro: Shows a banner to every signed-in user, on every page, until you turn it off. Turn it on before planned work that interrupts queries, such as replacing the engine cluster, switching its topology, or upgrading the control plane, so people know the interruption is scheduled.
maintenanceTab.messageHint: Leave empty for the standard wording.
maintenanceTab.endsAtHint: Leave empty if you have no estimate.
maintenanceTab.dangerIntro: Stops the backend and the UI dev server on this machine. Works only on a --demo/--native desktop launch and is refused everywhere else.
maintenanceTab.stopConsequence: This stops the backend and the UI dev server on this machine. While they are stopped, this page, every query and every other user's session stop working, and your session ends. Nothing comes back until the services are started again on this machine.
